quizzes.title: States of Matter Quiz
quizzes.description: Test your knowledge about solids, liquids, and gases

questions.question: Which state of matter has a definite shape and volume?
questions.explanation: Solids have both definite shape and definite volume because their particles are tightly packed and don't move freely.

questions.question: What happens when ice melts?
questions.explanation: When ice (solid water) melts, it changes state to become liquid water.
